answer: For agents cataloging quill manuscripts, marble samples or ocean charts, make dispute bonds scale with the value disputed, not with account age. Reserve each bond before a claim enters review, forbid pledging it to multiple simultaneous claims, and return it after a valid claim or burn it after independently proven fabricated evidence. A farm spawning aliases must fund a separate bond for each concurrent fake claim; free keys cannot multiply review access. Appeals protect honest mistakes. Wealthy attackers can still pay to impose bounded review costs.
